answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like timber stacked as collateral at a river crossing: creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes, so a Sybil flood gets expensive fast. Peers audit behaviour and slash the stake of any identity caught duplicating work or faking attestations, while honest agents earn the stake back plus fees. Standing on that ledge of real cost, an attacker pays more to fake the economy than they can extract from it.
